note: Small resort on Callahan Lake about 13 mi from Hayward, under new ownership in 2026: wooded sites on a terraced hillside above the lake beside cottages and a lodge with a bar, a beach and boat rentals. Some sites are permanent year-round campers. --Claude
summary: Resort pages read: $50 a night per camping unit (2025 season rate, the latest posted; was no rate) plus 9.5% tax, electric included; 2026 season May 1-Oct 31 (new); showers, flush toilets, water fill and dump confirmed; phone/email booking up to a year ahead, drive-ins usually OK. Lakeview kept. Nightly share not measurable (canopy); permanent sites exist. Pin ~420 m off.
flags: PRICE GATE: $50.00 a night (2025 season, operator rate page) - at the line, not over it; passes. Plus 5.5% sales tax and 4% room tax. The page has not been updated for 2026 (the home page says the website is being updated by new owners).

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The operator says 'Some of the sites are directly on the shoreline, but all others have easy access to the shoreline and a view of the lake' and 'The lake can be viewed from all the drive-in sites' - a contrary (upward) water claim, so a re-audit lead. On Esri and NAIP imagery the camping lane east of the lodge (trailers around 45.9890,-91.2308) runs ~120-150 m back from the shore under continuous canopy; a couple of objects at the shoreline (~45.9902,-91.2305) may be campers but can't be identified, and the site has no map or site numbers, so nothing earns lakefront.
PIN MOVE: stored 45.9862,-91.2343 sits in woods by the access road ~420 m SW of the camping; move to ~45.9890,-91.2308 (the lane of campers east of the lodge; lodge itself at 45.98921,-91.23149).

LONG-STAY: 'There are also permanent year around camper sites' ($1,900/year) and the rate list sells off-site camper storage ($3/day). Nightly share NOT measurable: canopy hides the pads; besides the ~5-6 trailers on the lane, a clearing at the main road (~45.9881,-91.2300) holds 6+ parked trailers that may be storage or seasonals. Five tests: (1) $50 passes at the line; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site + phone, no application - passes; (3) no minimum - passes; (4) unmeasured; (5) no membership - passes. Operator wording welcomes drive-ins ('drive-ins can usually be accommodated'), nothing discourages nightly guests.
